ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Debugger Registration Cmdline
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the registration of a debugger for a program that is available in the logon screen (sticky key backdoor).

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Image\\ File\\ Execution\\ Options\\\\.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*sethc\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*utilman\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*osk\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*magnify\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*narrator\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*displayswitch\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*atbroker\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*HelpPane\\\.exe.*")))
